segments.text: Okay wait, we're at a really nice restaurant,
segments.localized_text: 잠깐만, 우리 되게 좋은 레스토랑 왔는데,

segments.text: 5 bucks in your account last week.
I played Freecash this morning while I was waiting for you to get up.
segments.localized_text: 오늘 아침에 너 일어나는 거 기다리면서 Freecash 했거든.

segments.text: Here we go again.
Please don't tell me it's another one of those money games.
segments.localized_text: 또 그런 돈 버는 게임 아니라고 해줘.

segments.text: I tried one last month and you have to reach like 50 bucks just to cash out.
segments.localized_text: 지난달에 하나 해봤는데 출금하려면 50달러나 모아야 되더라고.

segments.text: And then they ghost you.
I know, most of them take ages.
That's why Freecash has a 4.7 on Trustpilot,
and they pay me on the same day, so the money's solid.
Also, the game developers pay to get real players,
segments.localized_text: 게다가 게임 개발사가 진짜 유저 모으려고 돈을 내는 거라,

segments.text: so you're basically earning that money passed to you to test and play the games.
segments.localized_text: 게임 테스트하고 플레이하면서 그 돈을 전달받는 거야.

segments.text: Okay, but how much are we actually talking,
like realistically?
43 dollars since this morning,
and that's just from playing games. They also got surveys
and app testing, too.
And that went to your PayPal? Like actual PayPal?
segments.localized_text: 그게 네 페이팔로 들어왔다고? 진짜 페이팔?

segments.text: PayPal, gift cards, bank transfers, whatever you prefer, and it's the same day.
segments.localized_text: 페이팔, 기프트카드, 계좌 이체 다 되고 원하는 대로 당일에 들어와.

segments.text: Why didn't you tell me? I want to game with you.
segments.localized_text: 왜 진작 말 안 했어? 나도 같이 게임할래.

segments.text: I'm telling you now, it's actually good timing.
They have a $10 sign-up bonus for whoever downloads the app this week.
segments.localized_text: 이번 주에 앱 다운로드하면 10달러 가입 보너스 주거든.

segments.text: All right, I'm getting it.
